physicalActivities.guideMeText: Lay supine. Keeping the back flat on the floor, bring the knees into the chest. Place the hands on the knees and gently pull them closer to the body until a stretch is felt in the lower back. Hold the stretch for the desired duration.

physicalActivities.guideMeText: Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Interlace the fingers and extend the arms straight overhead, palms facing the cieling. Hold the stretch for the desired duration.

physicalActivities.guideMeText: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, arms at sides. Extend the right arm overhead and slowly flex laterally to the left, reaching the left arm toward the ground until a stretch is felt in the right side. To deepen the stretch, continue to reach through the extended arm past vertical and toward to the opposite side. Be sure to keep the shoulders square and not to rotate through the hips. Hold the stretch for the desired duration.

Start in a table top position with the wrists under the shoulders and the knees under the hips. Sink the hips back towards the heels. Lower your body onto your thighs as you extend your arms out in front. Relax the muscles of your neck as you release your forehead towards the floor.
